accepted_sources.concise_video_summary: The video outlines a mean-reversion day trading strategy based on price deviation from a 20 SMA on 1-minute charts. It asserts that taking small Fibonacci retracement profits (e.g. 25% retracement of the impulse wave) yields a high win rate, while deeper retracements (>75%) signal potential trend reversals where position holding and higher risk-reward ratios can be targeted.
creator_claims: Achieves 90% win rate by targeting 25% retracement level
20 SMA is the only moving average needed for profitable trading
Rebound over 75% indicates trend change for high R:R trades
marketing_or_nonreproducible: Claiming 90% win rate without statistical backtest data or transaction fees considered
Promoting live trading signal rooms in the video description

candidate_strategy_mappings.local_test: Measure historical win rate and expectancy of taking profit at 0.25 vs 0.50 Fibonacci retracement levels following extreme z-score extension from 20 SMA
candidate_strategy_mappings.mechanism_fit: Maps to mean reversion mechanisms based on standard moving average distance

reproducible_mechanisms.entry_logic: Enter long/short counter-trend when price extends significantly away from the 20 SMA and shows initial reversal candle
entry_time_features: Fibonacci retracement level from preceding impulse high/low
reproducible_mechanisms.exit_logic: Exit at predefined Fibonacci retracement level of the impulse move, or at recent low/high as stop loss
failure_modes: Strong directional market trends causing price to continue extending away from the SMA without retracements
Slippage and transaction fees negating small fixed-percentage targets
reproducible_mechanisms.local_test_needed: Test mean reversion success rate on 1m crypto pairs when entry occurs at 2+ standard deviations from 20 SMA
reproducible_mechanisms.market_and_timeframe_context: High-frequency short-term intraday trading on 1m charts during volatile sessions
reproducible_mechanisms.mechanism: Counter-trend entry based on distance from moving average (mean reversion) with Fibonacci retracement targets
regime_conditions: High volatility extension away from 20 SMA
reproducible_mechanisms.risk_and_drawdown_control: Stop loss set at the extreme high/low of the impulse wave
